{{Quote|I have taken the time to memorize the languages of each and all my victims&mdash;the process demands but a few hours, akin to my learning the Mawanese vioflute, the drumheller harp, or Zeltronian lute.|Zeta Magnus|<ref name="SkyeWalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
The '''Zeltronian lute''', or '''Zeltron lute''', was a [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Music/Legends|musical]] instrument. [[King/Legends|King]] [[Arno (Zeltron)|Arno]] of [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]] was a skilled Zeltronian lute player.<ref name="Zeltros">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040105zeltros1|series=Zeltros: Pleasure Planet|text=Part 1: Who Doesn't Like Zeltrons?}}</ref> The [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Accelerated Transgenic Heuristic Abhorer|killing machine]] known as [[Zeta Magnus]] became proficient in the lute after learning it from the memories of an individual he [[Diet/Legends|digested]].<ref name="SkyeWalkers" />
